## What changes, and why

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change (git work uses `sandbox()` from test/helpers.ts)
- [ ] README, the matching HOW-IT-WORKS card and CHANGELOG's Unreleased section are updated if users see a difference
- [ ] A new or changed decision has an ADR
- [ ] No real names, email addresses or tokens (use octocat, octo-org, `*.example.invalid`)

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/makubexD/repown/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
